notes:
## Content and physical page
The author describes ideals and bands in the ordered set J/I notation, writes the difference formula (59) for a band, identifies the induced strata, defines the restricted V terms in (60), and writes two limit presentations in (61). This is a transcription of the stated claims, not a verification of them. There is no title or date. The dark authorial number is 35; the separate thin grey 78 at the lower left is another-hand foliation and is preserved as margin ink. Formula labels are 59, 60 and 61. No typescript, drawing or diagram appears on this leaf.

## Rereadings prompted by mathematics or letter shape
- Formula (59) was read as a whole on its crop, including both right-hand stars, the tilde over J, the prime on J′, the set-difference stroke, the cancelled continuation, and its unstruck period. Both RHS stars are positively present. No star has been removed to make the formula more conventional.
- The crossed formula's X, star and J stem are readable, but the putative tilde cannot be separated from the crossing strokes. Its existing tilde/J doubt remains.
- Formula (60) and the following index line were reread together. The first and final V subscripts each show a single continuous bar; the middle subscript uses separated short strokes. The manuscript distinction is retained following C's transcription convention. The superscripts J and Z and the digits 0 and 1 were checked on the ink. The capital V is rounded; this page alone does not establish a separate semantic roman/calligraphic alphabet, so C's V convention is retained rather than counting H's mathcal as an additional reading.
- The whole two-row formula (61) was cropped and reread because of the doubtful upper limit sign. The two rules under lim have upturned/thickened right ends that do not unambiguously separate an arrowhead from a terminal return. M0661 remains unresolved; a matching narrow doubt is added to the lower lim. The indexed V terms, J superscripts, i0...in and Drap(J) were reread, and no distinct extra equality bar was found under the small less-than signs.
- The last cancelled à initially resembled a colon. A separate crop of the live associés à la stratification gives the same reduced lower letter body and detached accent. This establishes a page-local accented-a habit and supports retaining à in the cancelled line; the visible two-dot outline is not silently taken as punctuation.
- The final cancelled de was compared with this page's other de forms: the trailing motion belongs to the e; no separate final s is visible.

## Source cancellations and uncertainty
All three cancelled regions are retained. The last line is incomplete as written and is not completed. No authorial question mark or explicit mathematical reservation was found. The uncertainty concerning the starred cancelled X and the limit rules is the reader's, not a claim that the author expressed doubt. The first i in the opening hypothesis is heavily retraced; there is no separately recoverable underlying letter, and no independent deletion is invented. The right note's c'est is medium-confidence and is assigned its own blind region. No proof check or mathematical use was performed.

### Blind-reading corrections

The independent reading led to a second inspection of every differing region. The continuation notation in (60), its following line and (61) is now distinguished as one rule, two rules, or point-plus-rule according to the ink. The first line also carries a local doubt about a possible overwritten x beneath the final i. The crossed separator after j0 and the compact inequalities below the lower limit remain uncertain. Both limits retain the rule/arrow doubt; the rule is now the first alternative for both. The letters of Drap and the crossed words dans la remain readable, and the cropped upper fragments in B06 do not replace the full-line reading alors on a. No new mathematical proof claim is made by these decisions.
